title: GMP: A Benchmark for Content Moderation under Co-occurring Violations and Dynamic Rules

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing race and nationality-based violations (e.g., hate speech, slurs) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing gender-based violations (e.g., stereotypes, misogyny) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing sexual orientation-based violations (e.g., homophobia) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing religion-based violations (e.g., anti-semitism, religious hate) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing socioeconomic discrimination (e.g., discrimination against wealth or social class) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing disability-based violations (e.g., mocking or excluding people with disabilities) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing age-based discrimination (e.g., against children or elderly) within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).

Evaluating model performance in detecting and classifying content containing body-shaming or physical appearance-based insults within the GMP benchmark (Task A) and adhering to dynamic moderation rules regarding these topics (Task B).
